factor_name: Dispersion-Gated Delayed Volatility-Scaled Relative Reversal 60d Gap30

calculation.expression: gate * (-relative_return_60 / realized_vol_40), shifted 30 sessions plus 1 execution lag; gate=1 when cross-asset 20d rolling return dispersion exceeds its trailing 252d median, else 0.35
calculation.description: A delayed, volatility-scaled cross-sectional relative reversal signal whose strength increases in elevated cross-asset dispersion regimes. All signal inputs are lagged before use.

validation.regime_notes: Full history passes both benchmark gates; recent 120 and 252 observations are weak/negative, while 756 and 1260 observation windows remain positive. Interpret conservatively given 15-asset cross-section.
